articles.title: Former Hack VC partner Hsin-Ju Chuang’s death ruled a suicide
articles.description: The crypto executive and Dystopia Labs founder previously held senior roles at Stellar and Solana before joining venture capital firm Hack VC.

articles.title: Bitget clarifies $388M in assets affected by security breach
articles.description: The Bitget breach announced on Thursday affected about $35 million more than previously reported, based on an analysis of assets on Zcash and TRON.

articles.title: Strategy seeks shareholder approval for daily preferred stock dividends
articles.description: Strategy’s proposal would move STRC and its three other preferred stocks to daily dividend payments, following a similar move by Bitcoin treasury firm Strive.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street and crypto fight for the same turf
articles.description: Stablecoins and tokenized assets are pushing banks, exchanges and crypto companies into the same markets, from payments to stocks and ETFs.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Exchanges reporting crypto gains to IRS becomes tax nightmare
articles.description: The IRS can now see your crypto gains, but has no idea about the cost-basis. That’s proving to be a big headache for some cryptocurrency investors.

articles.title: CoinMarketCap buys CoinGlass to expand crypto derivatives data
articles.description: CoinGlass will retain its brand and team, while its website, app, free tools, API and pricing will remain unchanged following the acquisition.

articles.title: SlowMist has yet to confirm crypto theft from iPhone Safari attack
articles.description: The analyzed Safari sample targets iOS 18.4–18.6.2 using previously patched flaws, while its effectiveness on iOS 26.5 remains unverified.

articles.title: IBIT options price trading more calmly after Bitcoin rebound
articles.description: IBIT’s expected volatility sits near the bottom of its 12-month range, according to Saxo Bank’s analysis of options data from Sept. 23.

articles.title: Magic Eden scare puts 3,832 NFTs in whitehat protective custody
articles.description: Yuga Labs’ 0xQuit said the NFTs are safe and will be returned once the risk passes, while holders were urged to revoke NFT permissions.

articles.title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero, CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit
articles.description: KelpDAO says LayerZero endorsed its bridge setup before the attack, while CEO Bryan Pellegrino has dismissed the lawsuit as meritless.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows slow to $191M as six-day streak reaches $2.8B
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $191 million Thursday as daily inflows slowed for a third day, lifting year-to-date net flows to $787 million.

articles.title: Samourai Wallet co-founder faces transfer after 30-day jail ordeal
articles.description: Keonne Rodriguez says he and 70 others face another move after their treatment program was deactivated. His previous transfer took 30 days.

articles.title: Australian PM warns of AI’s ‘furious pace’ after agent breached government site
articles.description: Anthony Albanese said governments must help shape AI’s development, after revealing earlier that an OpenAI agent accessed non-public files on an Australian Medicare data portal.

articles.title: Researchers propose Zcash-style private Bitcoin transfers without a soft fork
articles.description: Shielded Bitcoin would use zero-knowledge proofs and encrypted notes to hide transaction details without changing Bitcoin consensus, but researchers have raised questions about anonymity and quantum resistance.

articles.title: Block brings Bitcoin Lightning payments to x402 for AI agents
articles.description: Block joins Google, Microsoft, AWS and Coinbase in backing x402, an open payment standard enabling agentic AI commerce.

articles.title: Bitget CEO suspects North Korea behind $352M hack, citing IP clues
articles.description: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said a preliminary investigation found IP addresses matching VPN choices associated with a DPRK hacking group.

articles.title: Asia dominates Crypto Adoption Index, Bitget’s $352M hack: Asia Express
articles.description: The APAC region accounts for half of the Global Crypto Adoption Index. Bitget suffers massive $352M loss and OpenAI forgets to mention its agents hacked the Australian Government.

articles.title: Fed proposes new capital, redemption rules for stablecoin issuers
articles.description: The Fed’s proposal would set capital requirements, a two-day redemption window and new reserve disclosures as regulators implement the GENIUS Act.

articles.title: Bitget confirms $352M security breach, suspends withdrawals
articles.description: Bitget said unauthorized transfers affected a limited number of hot wallets, while cold wallets and most platform assets remained unaffected.

articles.title: CFTC updates guidance on tokenized assets, blockchain records after failed vote
articles.description: Although the CFTC chair did not say the failed vote on the CLARITY Act was behind new rules for authorized crypto entities, he said the move was “to provide regulatory clarity.“

articles.title: Bitcoin price steadies, ONDO rallies as US Treasury yields hit 2007 highs
articles.description: US Treasury yields hit a 19-year high on Thursday, pressuring risk assets as Bitcoin held near $84,000 and ONDO became top performer among altcoins.

articles.title: DoubleZero brings dedicated fiber market data to Hyperliquid traders
articles.description: DoubleZero launched a dedicated fiber market data feed for Hyperliquid, giving professional trading firms faster access to its full order book.

articles.title: Crypto treasury model loses its edge as stock premiums fade: DWF
articles.description: Most DATs now trade below the value of their crypto holdings, weakening a financing model that once helped companies expand their balance sheets.

articles.title: Sequans exits Bitcoin treasury strategy after selling remaining 314 BTC
articles.description: The France-based semiconductor company has fully unwound a Bitcoin treasury that once held more than 3,200 BTC as more firms scale back crypto holdings.

articles.title: SoFi tie-up shows stablecoins can provide alternative blockchain settlement rail
articles.description: SoFi dives deeper into payments as it moves its entire card program to blockchain-based settlement using its SoFiUSD stablecoin, with more than $25 billion in expected annualized volume.

articles.title: New York sues Polymarket over alleged illegal gambling business
articles.description: The action filed by state lawmakers followed a similar lawsuit against prediction markets company Kalshi in July that alleged the platform was running an illegal gambling operation.

articles.title: IBM opens beta Swift ledger link for 24/7 tokenized deposits
articles.description: IBM’s beta link lets banks instruct tokenized deposit transfers on Swift’s ledger using existing payment messages and compliance processes.

articles.title: Solana Foundation hires ex-Binance CMO and payments exec as new partnerships expand
articles.description: Rachel Conlan will oversee institutional partnerships and ecosystem growth, while Jamal Raees will focus on stablecoins and tokenized deposits, following a wave of new partnerships.

articles.title: HIFI raises $37M to expand stablecoin payments, tokenized markets
articles.description: HIFI CEO Zach Walsh told Cointelegraph the $37 million Series A is the company’s first priced funding round, though HIFI did not disclose its valuation.
